title: The explicit universal Askey-Wilson homomorphism into U q sl2 tensored with the Laurent polynomial algebra in three independent indeterminates is injective over a field for nonzero q with fourth power different from one
author: Paul Terwilliger
work: The Universal Askey-Wilson Algebra and the Equitable Presentation of U_q(sl_2)
source_version: Official SIGMA 7 (2011) article 099, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2011.099; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

source_locator.theorem: Theorem 2.18 with the explicit homomorphism of Theorem 2.16
source_locator.label: thm:main3

difficulty_reason: Checking the defining relations only constructs a homomorphism and cannot establish its faithfulness. The author builds a grading adapted to the equitable quantum generators, controls highest and lowest components of ordered Askey-Wilson monomials, and proves algebraic independence in the zero-degree Laurent algebra. Two extremal-component arguments then rule out every possible nonzero kernel element.
